scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The all-n characterization is proved from bipartite balance, domination, and Hall’s theorem; finite enumeration independently stress-tests the statement.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The theorem is restricted to standard crown graphs with n at least 3. Exhaustive verification covers n from 3 through 8 and is not used as the infinite proof. A publicly retrievable 2016 paired-domination-polynomial item was only a one-page abstract, so exact historical priority for the crown polynomial remains a residual literature-access risk.
